data.eligibility_content:
The eligibility criteria for the NMIMS online MBA course are as follows:

The interested candidate must have completed a bachelor's degree with a 10+2+3 educational qualification from a recognized university.

The applicant must have scored a minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the graduation level (45% for reserved category students, SC/ST/OBC/PwD).
data.specializations_intro: The NMIMS online MBA is offered in 7 industry-centric specializations, which develop core competencies across different industries, depending on the student's preference.
data.admission_steps:
To enroll in the NMIMS online MBA course, follow the below listed step-by-step admission process for a hassle-free enrollment procedure:

  1. Visit the official website of NMIMS Online and register.
  2. Complete the registration process to receive credentials to access the admission portal.
  3. Start filling out the application form with accurate information.
  4. Attach the supporting documents and submit the NMIMS online MBA application form.
  5. The university will verify the application form, documents, and fee.
  6. Once the verification is completed, the university will issue a "student number" and dispatch your study kit along with the activation of the student portal and LMS.
data.about_content:
The NMIMS (Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies) offers a globally recognized online MBA (Master of Business Administration) course under its Centre for Distance and Online Education department, abbreviated as NMIMS Online. It is a 2 year postgraduate degree program with a 100% online learning mode.

The NMIMS online MBA assists students in becoming industry-ready professionals with practical learning experience. The course delivery method includes guidance from renowned academicians and 24*7 access to live/recorded lectures. For better industry relevance, the course is offered in 7 different specializations spanning multiple disciplines with an in-depth emphasis on the core understanding of the sector.

The institute has 40+ years of excellence in multidisciplinary education, which makes its online MBA program an ideal choice to build a successful professional career. For a better learning experience, students are provided with e-books, journals, and lecture transcripts. With the assistance of renowned faculty, the NMIMS online MBA enhances the essential skills among students to provide a pathway to immense success.

reviews.review_text: The best thing I liked about the online MBA course at NMIMS was the extended course duration. Due to some issues, I dropped out for a year, but later on managed to complete my program within a span of 3 years.
For me NMIMS online MBA was up to the mark and met all my expectations. However, there is a little scope for improvement, but overall, I had a good experience.
I recently graduated from the NMIMS online MBA program, and it is a worthwhile option due to its minimal interaction with faculty and self paced learning facility.
The online MBA course at Narsee Monjee also offers career services that I liked the most, and on behalf of it, I recommend it to others too.

data.placement_content:
To offer a promising professional career ahead for students enrolled in the NMIMS online MBA course, the university offers dedicated placement assistance with personalized career services. They have witnessed a 40% improvement in the profile ranking of enrolled students and provide 6 months of access to relevant opportunities via job portals like Updazz, IIMJobs, and Hirist.

The career services offered under the NMIMS online MBA placement assistance are:

  • Job portal access.
  • Career coaching.
  • Practice interviews.
  • Profile development (CV guidance, LinkedIn optimization, etc).

These career services also provide AI-powered personalized recommendations to boost your profile based on company insights. The university has 500+ hiring partners with 20000+ recruiters shaping students' careers. Some of the leading hiring partners include:

  • ICICI Securities
  • Oracle
  • WIPRO BPO
  • Goldman Sachs
  • Tesco
  • Mercedes Benz
data.syllabus_content:
The course syllabus is designed by industry experts and qualified professionals to offer insights into several essential key management concepts. The NMIMS online MBA syllabus follows a semester pattern, and for a better course understanding, the detailed syllabus of the marketing specialization is listed below:

Year I

Semester I

  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics & Macro Economics
  • Organisational Behaviour
  • Marketing Management
  • Quantitative Methods – I

Semester II

  • Cost & Management Accounting
  • Human Resource Management
  • Strategic Management
  • Business Analytics
  • Legal Aspect of Business
  • Operations Management

Year II

Semester III

  • Corporate Finance
  • Research Methodology
  • Project Pre-work
  • Brand Management
  • Consumer Behaviour
  • Integrated Marketing Communications
  • Sales Management

Semester IV

  • Indian Ethos & Ethics
  • Corporate Sustainability
  • International Business
  • Project
  • International Marketing
  • Services Marketing
  • Digital Marketing

faqs.question: Is NMIMS online good for an MBA?
faqs.answer: The top-notch academic quality with world-class student support services, NMIMS online is an ideal and good choice for an MBA.

faqs.question: What is the cost of an NMIMS online MBA?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS online MBA costs INR 1,96,000 /- for the entire 2 year course if the enrolled student opts for a one-time payment plan.

faqs.question: What is the average package for the NMIMS distance MBA?
faqs.answer: The average package for the NMIMS distance MBA varies between INR 4 & INR 7 LPA.

faqs.question: Is an NMIMS online degree valid?
faqs.answer: Yes, the University Grants Commission (UGC) has recognized the NMIMS online degree program, which makes it equivalent to regular degree courses.

faqs.question: Which is better, symbiosis or NMIMS for an online MBA?
faqs.answer: Both universities are globally recognized and offer valid degree courses. However, symbiosis is more renowned with several international rankings, making it a better option to consider.
